claim_ceiling: Pointwise optical tidal matrix calculated from the local Riemann tensor. This is not a parallel-transported Sachs solver, propagated optical Jacobi matrix, caustic solver, or wave-optics calculation.

conventions.optical_tidal_definition: T_AB = R_(mu nu rho sigma) e_A^mu k^nu e_B^rho k^sigma
conventions.screen_frame: two contravariant coordinate vectors orthonormal and transverse to k
conventions.screen_frame_transport: not yet implemented; pointwise basis must be supplied at each event

regression_cases.analytic_reason: A radial principal null direction in Schwarzschild has vanishing screen-projected Weyl optical tide; Ricci is zero.

regression_cases.local_screen_basis_convention: reference=[0,0,1]; first=normalize(reference cross direction); second=normalize(direction cross first)

independent_sympy_comparator.note: Independent symbolic-metric/Riemann contraction with the same tetrad and local frame convention; verifies a nonzero trace-free tidal matrix, not Rust output.

supply a non-orthonormal pair of screen vectors

classify a caustic from a small determinant without a transported screen and root convergence
compare curvature-based tidal results to the canonical variational map without matching affine normalization and screen gauge
